text: I'm a foster carer and have a little boy aged 2 with me. Temperature this evening is 38.5. He's been pulling at his right ear quite a bit and told me "ear hurt" when I asked. I've given him a dose of paracetamol about half an hour ago. I'll need to let his social worker know in the morning either way, but I'd like advice on whether this can wait for the GP tomorrow or if he should be seen sooner.
